The '''Pharine Delta''' was a portion of the [[Pharine River]], which flowed through the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phemiss]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. The [[Water/Legends|delta]] contained several islands and emptied into the [[Tsilor Sea]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pharine Delta was introduced in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
